Process lesson: a platform-drift course cannot be audited from training data. Three of the highest-value findings (the GPT-creation closure, the Claude training-policy reversal, the Google price cut) were invisible to memory and only surfaced by reading vendor pages. An agent reported Zapier at 10,072+ apps where the rendered page said 9,000+, and reported ChatGPT Israeli prices in shekels that a second source gave in dollars.
